title: C-O1 fix round: isolate ORCH_NOTIFY_URL and ORCH_NOTIFY_DESKTOP in the daemon test suite
spec: Fix round for T-0078 (review T-0085, severity high): tests/test_daemon.py setUp() never clears ORCH_NOTIFY_URL, so with the variable set in the ambient environment (which README now recommends) every notify() call in the suite fires a real POST; the reviewer measured 10 real hits across 20 tests. This worktree is cut from task/T-0078, so the daemon.py change is already here; touch only tests/test_daemon.py. In the test case's setUp (or a module-level fixture the daemon tests share), pop ORCH_NOTIFY_URL and ORCH_NOTIFY_DESKTOP from os.environ and register cleanup that restores the previous values, using the same pattern the new set_env helper uses; the three webhook tests then opt in explicitly through set_env. Add one test that runs an internal notify() path (for example the held-task path already exercised by an existing test) with a local http.server standing in for a stale ambient ORCH_NOTIFY_URL set before setUp, and asserts the server received zero requests. Commit on this branch when green.
acceptance: tests/test_daemon.py: setUp clears ORCH_NOTIFY_URL and ORCH_NOTIFY_DESKTOP and restores them in cleanup
New test ambient_notify_url_does_not_leak_into_other_tests passes: an ambient URL set before setUp receives zero requests from a non-webhook test
`ORCH_NOTIFY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/x uv run python -m unittest tests.test_daemon` is green with no connection attempts outside the three webhook tests
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green

result.summary:
Committed on `task/T-0087`.

**Summary:** `tests/test_daemon.py`'s `setUp` now pops `ORCH_NOTIFY_URL` and `ORCH_NOTIFY_DESKTOP` from `os.environ` and restores them via `addCleanup` (new `clear_env` helper, same pop/restore pattern as the existing `set_env`). Added `test_ambient_notify_url_does_not_leak_into_other_tests`, which stands up a local `http.server`, simulates a stale ambient `ORCH_NOTIFY_URL` pointing at it, re-runs the clearing logic, then drives `daemon.gate()`'s worktree-missing path (which calls `notify()` internally) and asserts the server got zero requests.

**Files changed:** `tests/test_daemon.py` only.

**Test output:** `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` → 91 tests, OK. `ORCH_NOTIFY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/x uv run python -m unittest tests.test_daemon` → 21 tests, OK, with webhook-attempt log lines appearing only for the two tests that opt in via `set_env` and the new regression test. `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` gate: exit 0. No failures to report.
